evaluation.rationale: The candidate notes capture an extraordinary amount of detail, retaining every single fact from the transcript. However, the notes suffer from severe structural and conciseness issues. The text is bloated with 15 overlapping sections, causing the same facts to be repeated 5-10 times. Furthermore, because the notes act as an unedited chronological dump, they report superseded values (HW4 due Friday, midterm covering lectures 1-8, 4 nodes tolerating 2 failures, Kofi posting the practice midterm) as definitive facts, action items, and decisions alongside their corrected values. This creates direct contradictions and material errors, severely impacting factual accuracy, numeric accuracy, and timeline accuracy. The inclusion of almost all distractors and irrelevant small talk further degrades readability and conciseness.
